svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print on its side, 100 % infill: a C shape 40 mm wide, 21 mm deep and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 52 mm tall; back 6 mm, top jaw 4 mm, bottom jaw 6 mm thick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Opening between the jaws 42 mm, for module frames 30 to 40 mm deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom jaw: 6.6 mm hole 14 mm in from the back face, centred; an M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nut sits in a hex pocket on top, or tap the jaw M6 directly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back: two 4.4 mm holes, 12 mm each side of centre, 15 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top; two M4 x 12 screws go into the housing's inserts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the top jaw rests on the frame's top edge and the thumb screw

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: presses up under the frame's bottom flange; the cell then lies about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm above the glass and parallel to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a frame offcut, the pod cannot rock when the screw is snug.
